triggerReasons.message: Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Bug, regression, security/auth/session, benchmark, or explicit behavior-change work should have red evidence.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: The new decision document exists and contains the evidence table, five cohesive workstreams, dependency order, verification matrix, risk controls, rollback, and explicit non-goals.
acceptanceBindings.note: The complete document is accepted only when all ten independent content and regression checks pass.
